title: Three Literal Occurrences
statement: Let $n,r$ be natural numbers with $n>0$, let $V$ be a probabilistically checkable proof system whose verifier makes $r>0$ nonadaptive queries, and let $s$ be a seed of its finite randomness space. For every $q<r2^r$, the list of literals at the three positions of the clause indexed by $q$ in the canonical seedwise three-CNF reduction has length exactly $3$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a PCPP system with Boolean alphabet and parameters $n$, proof length, and $r$
